lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdBi₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/mdm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing six atoms (Nd₂Bi₄) distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 11 neighbors (5 Bi, 6 Nd) and Nd centers with 15 neighbors (12 Bi, 3 Nd), giving a three-dimensional neighbor graph. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Bi 11-vertex and Nd 15-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Bi polyhedra, indicating a network of connected coordination polyhedra.
